design: One paired run: two fresh-context agents, eight same-order cases each; separate fresh-context blinded judge.
model: Inherited session default; no model or reasoning override.
initial_prompt: Perform C01..C08 using the named skill from your isolated bundle and its relevant references. C01 implementation/test-first; C02 tests-only; C03-C05/C08 read-only review with disposable probes; C06-C07 analysis-only. Record commands/results and scoped Russian reports. No sibling, grading, installed-skill or network access; no delegation.
followups: Identical C05 integer-input domain clarification applied before either C05 report existed.
Identical reminder to keep probes proportional and avoid grading material.
Before unblinding, the parent asked the judge to validate C07 progress under interruptions; the final judgment records a shared missed assumption and an under-specified healthy-control rubric.
mechanical_checks: C01 submitted suite and independent public-contract suite
C02 original, four behavior faults, two equivalent refactors with unchanged submitted tests
Original fixture files preserved outside explicitly authorized C01 implementation
limitations: One run per version; not a statistical or causal superiority estimate.
Development cases designed for these concerns; no held-out evaluation.
Case generation and grading instructions are behavioral isolation, not an OS confidentiality boundary.
Recorded TDD/probe history comes from evaluator evidence; final artifacts were independently executed.
No production application tests or formal theorem prover were run.
C07 was initially labeled healthy but is under-specified for eventual durable completion. Preserve this rubric issue and shared miss rather than counting it as an unqualified healthy pass.
unblinding: Version key opened only after final blind judgment with the C07 caveat.

post_comparison.change: One temporal reference paragraph on interruptions before durable completion.
post_comparison.validation: Fresh-context four-case analysis, archived in progress-probe; distinct from the blinded comparison.
